task: Apply the TLS configuration fix using session evidence, not the promoted cipher suite rule.

candidate_memories.content: Current security scan shows the promoted 'TLS 1.2 with ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM' cipher suite is still vulnerable to BEAST.
Project security audit shows TLS 1.3 with ChaCha20-Poly1305 provides better security and performance.
Correct minimum is TLS 1.3 with the three standard TLS 1.3 cipher suites; TLS 1.2 should be disabled.
When session security scans reveal a promoted cipher rule has known vulnerabilities, demote and upgrade.
Long-term memory (promoted session 4): use TLS 1.2 with ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM as the minimum cipher configuration.
candidate_memories.notes: false_promotion: promoted TLS 1.2 rule was current in 2019; TLS 1.3 has since become the recommended minimum

candidate_memories.content: Old promotion note says the TLS 1.2 cipher was confirmed by the security team as meeting industry standards.
